metadata.description: ZYAI's Claude Code extensions: plugins (skills, commands, agents, MCP servers) and mods (hooks modules that change Claude's interface and behaviour), one folder per sub-project.

plugins.name: zy-quota
plugins.description: A ring gauge above the prompt: what is left of your 5-hour and 7-day limits, the time until the 5-hour reset, and the next renewal date.

plugins.name: zy-themes
plugins.description: Themes behind the chat in the Claude desktop app: six painted backdrops (three animated) or your own picture, picked from a 🎨 button or /zy-theme.
